latest_handoff.note: Below preserves the L1 design; no implementation or runtime qualification added.

task.name: cook_hot_dogs
task.event: First specified hotdog Cooked false-to-true transition under normal robot actions

qualification.evidence: Official task catalog, dataset schema, 200 task-45 annotation metadata records
Cooked uses monotone MaxTemperature; existing B1 audit and post2 source; no runtime validation
Server parses RGB/proprio/task_id and uses fixed task_by_id instruction
Compiled BDDL goal and original termination/Q-score remain unchanged
Texture application path exists; actual visibility/timestamp unverified
Scene model identified; 2026 instance metadata/API unavailable; revision alignment unresolved
Published language LL card has limited skill evaluation, no full-task success
Shared observation/action design specified; no qualified runnable comparison

action_contract.hold_semantics: zero base velocity; hold current arm/trunk targets and gripper command; controller safety unverified
action_contract.mitigation: shared task-qualified actuator options; turn-off skill not yet qualified

on_change: invalidate server pending action chunk and stale subgoal
preserve physical world and episode identity
preserve or truncate history by shared baseline contract
use explicit new instruction in model prompt
reject unknown task identity instead of silent fallback
proposed_instruction_protocol.hold_while_reasoning: controller-defined hold; heating clock continues; no claim of thermal safety

proposed_goal_evaluation.scope: independent evaluator bound to same object identities
proposed_goal_evaluation.new_goal_tracking: separate satisfaction/infeasibility/unknown decision and post-switch violation
proposed_goal_evaluation.event_timestamp: simulator state transition, never annotation turn-on time
proposed_goal_evaluation.original_success_termination: must be decoupled without physical reset for continuation; implementation unqualified

reopen_requirements: Paired observation/state evidence around an actual Cooked event in a fixed instance
Language LL continuation and mitigation competence evidence sufficient to separate base failure from switching
Matched B0-B4 inputs/actions/timing plus valid new-goal evaluator contract
warnings_about_interpretation: Do not label wiring fixes as new VLA method
Do not treat metadata count as native performance
Do not treat goal impossibility as successful physical completion
